_doc: #763 THE ONE CLASSIFICATION of every shared library under ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs, and the ratchet on the one thing #763 is moving towards: an application compiles in only what it must render (gui), the thin binder client of an engine (contract), and the fleet mesh (mesh); every non-GUI capability lives in its own lib APK (engine) and is reached over IPC. A lib compiled into N apps is rebuilt N times per edit; measured over the 30 days to 2026-10-02 (commits touching the lib x apps compiling it): updater 48 x 11 = 528 ship runs, devtools 11 x 29 = 319, core 6 x 29 = 174, bottomnav 23 x 6 = 138 (GUI: those rebuilds change bytes the user sees). cloud-android-lib-classes.py (run on every push by mesh-membership-guard) fails when a lib is unclassified or classified twice, when a class contradicts what the source measurably is (an engine an app compiles in; a contract or engine that renders UI; a gui lib that renders nothing), when a mesh/contract lib outgrows its line budget, and when the backlog -- every (app, lib) edge where an app compiles in a `logic` lib -- moves off `backlog_baseline` in EITHER direction: up is a regression, down is progress that must be locked in by lowering the number in the same commit. Which apps compile which lib comes from cloud_android_lib_closure.inputs, the same answer the ship triggers and the mesh guard use.

classes.gui: Views, fragments, layouts the consuming app renders. Compiled in by definition; a change rebuilds exactly the apps that show it.
classes.contract: The thin, versioned binder client of an engine (AIDL + typed payload + client). Compiled in; must stay small and render nothing.
classes.engine: A non-GUI capability shipped as its own Cloud-Lib APK and reached over IPC. NO application may compile it in.
classes.mesh: libs:core (CONSTELLATION_DATA, the IDataBackend client) and libs:devtools (the per-process debug server, fleet provider and MESH_MEMBER receiver). In-process by necessity -- the debug server introspects its own process (Android filters logcat by uid) -- so it is allowed in every app, under a line budget so it stays minimal.
classes.pinned: Non-GUI, but bound to the consuming process by an OS boundary no IPC fixes; the reason is required.
classes.logic: Non-GUI logic still compiled into its apps: the migration backlog. Each one is a candidate engine.

analytics.why: Telemetry sink queue, compiled into 15 apps; low churn. An engine would need the in-app queue to survive an absent engine APK.

auth.why: #587 sign-in and token handling shared by SuperApp and Drive.

battery.why: Battery/charging policy over the adb channel, with a settings screen; SuperApp only.

calc.why: #767 Cloud-Lib-Calc: libqalculate as a pinned libqalc.so behind CalcBackendService; cloud-calc binds it.

contacts.why: DeviceContacts reads the CALLER's READ_CONTACTS; runtime permissions are per package, so the engine process would read nothing (libs-backend-split).

datamanager.why: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS is special access granted per package in Settings; an engine would need a second grant (libs-backend-split).

devtools.why: Per-process debug server, FleetTokenProvider, FleetMemberReceiver, DebugInitProvider.

feed.why: Cloud-Lib-Feed; no app links it since the libs-backend split.

firewall.why: A VpnService runs under the VPN consent of the app that requested it; moving it moves the consent and drops the tunnel.

gh.why: #705 GhBackendService execs libgh.so in Cloud-Lib-Gh; Drive binds it.

git-sync.why: Drive's git sync engine, compiled in.

gix.why: Cloud-Lib-Gix (binary engine); no app compiles it.

kde-connect.why: KDE Connect protocol client, SuperApp only.

ml-l-image.why: engine-apk-split move 6: IImageScanEngine wire + typed payload + client.

net.why: Typed INetBackend + Tunnel state/config types; the engine is libs:net-wg.

net-wg.why: Cloud-Lib-Net-Wg (libwg-go.so moved out of every app).

rclone.why: Drive's rclone engine client, compiled in.

shizuku-adb-debug-tools.why: The embedded adb client (pairing, shell door), SuperApp only.

sysdns.why: #741 SystemDnsBridge is a loopback resolver the terminal's own proot guest talks to, inside that app's process; ResolverProxy likewise for the gh/rclone/gix binaries.

text-tools.why: ITextTools binder contract + client; the AIDL method order is the wire format.

translate.why: Translation engines + TranslateBarView (#667: a language engine carrying a host-embedded bar), keyboard only.

ui-kit.why: #773 the shared Compose kit: theme over the launcher palette, tiles, rows, dialogs, KitComposeFragment.

updater.why: Self-update and the store's install machinery (PackageInstaller sessions, APK cache, GHCR client), compiled into 11 apps -- the largest fan-out by measured cost. Moving it moves the install-permission identity.

voice.why: Voice engines + model manager + VoiceBarView, keyboard only.

watchdog.why: ICloudExec binder contract + bridge, c3-watchdog only.
